words.gloss: he who resides in my heart

literal: Since the lover is the resident of my heart, knowing the burning, I fear eating hot food.
translation: Since my beloved resides within my heart, I fear to eat hot food, knowing that the heat might burn him.
modern: என் காதலர் என் நெஞ்சத்தில் இருப்பதால், சூடான உணவை உண்பதால் அவருக்குச் சூடு பட்டுவிடுமோ என்று அஞ்சி, நான் சூடான உணவை உண்ண அஞ்சுகிறேன்.
explanation: This couplet beautifully illustrates the depth of the heroine's love through a tender, imaginative fear. She believes her lover physically resides inside her heart. Consequently, she fears eating hot food because she knows the heat might burn him. This hyperbolic expression shows how her thoughts are entirely consumed by her beloved, to the extent that even her basic daily actions are performed with his comfort in mind.
